mutations.name: an absent input passes
kills: evaluateFact an input with no valid marker at its current pin makes the dependent absent, even with equal recorded digests

mutations.name: validity compares the recorded pin, breaking the cutoff
kills: evaluateFact an input re-run with an unchanged projection digest keeps every dependent valid, two levels down

mutations.name: drift is dropped
kills: evaluateFact H-L5: a step is not re-run when an input changes outside its projection, and the drift is reported

mutations.name: the step's own pin is evaluated before its inputs
kills: evaluateFact inputs are checked first: an absent input is the reason even when the step's own pin also moved

mutations.name: a TTL pin is still valid at its expiry
kills: evaluateFact C3: a TTL-pinned observed fact is valid before its expiry and absent at it
